## What is compared {.unnumbered}

Every row is one real clip (one microphone, level-matched to the same RMS)
and two synthetic renders driven by **that clip's own rotor-speed
trajectories**: a random draw of the rig's preset from
`conf/online_mix/rig_fm_5050.yaml` (`line_mode: fm` — tones on a jittering
shared shaft, blade-passing emphasis, the rig's floor curve, its amplitude
process and microphone structure), and a random draw of the old hand-ranged
family (`conf/online_mix/salv2_stoch.yaml` defaults, filtered-noise lines)
that the earlier synthetic-only regressors were trained on. Spectrograms are
2048/512 Hann, 0–8 kHz, one colour scale per row (70 dB range). The renders
are *random draws*, not fits to the clip: timbre, floor jitter and drifts are
sampled from the rig's ranges, only the trajectories are shared.

What to listen for: the pitch and its motion follow the trajectory in all
three; the rig preset should carry the recording's balance of comb and
broadband floor (DREGON: a heavy low-frequency flow-noise floor with a comb
that fades by 3 kHz; Michael's: a dominant blade-passing tone with faint odd
orders and a quiet floor), the old family a flat, over-complete comb.
Assets are built by `rig-model-listening/build.py`; the quantitative
comparison (line level per order, floor per band, coherent share, floor
envelope statistics) is in `docs/experiments/stochastic-fit.md`.

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

here = Path("rig-model-listening")
index = json.loads((here / "index.json").read_text())
for rig, title in (("dregon", "DREGON"), ("michaels", "Michael's rig")):
    print(f"\n## {title}\n")
    for e in [x for x in index if x["rig"] == rig]:
        slug = e["slug"]
        print(f"\n### {e['clip']} — {e['label']} ({e['dur']} s)\n")
        print(f"![]({here.name}/{slug}.png){{width=100%}}\n")
        print('<table style="width:100%"><tr>')
        for name, label in (("real", "real recording"), ("rig", "rig preset, same RPS"), ("old", "old family, same RPS")):
            print(f'<td style="text-align:center"><b>{label}</b><br><audio controls preload="none" src="{here.name}/{slug}_{name}.wav"></audio></td>')
        print("</tr></table>\n")
```
